attributes.scope: Windows Git worktrees sharing ignored GDL build inputs

subject: project:gdl
value: Never junction or symlink a worker worktree's ignored orig/ or build/ path to the shared checkout. Native git worktree remove can follow the reparse point and delete shared inputs. Copy only the exact required ignored files, and reject or remove reparse points before worktree removal.
